dialogues.text: Albedo is steadfast, intelligent, and treats everyone with kindness and respect. I think most people would agree with that assessment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's also a calculated thinker. It's fair to say that, if he did commit a crime, it would likely be well-concealed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Up until now, Albedo has never displayed any ill-will toward humanity, and he also still seems like his normal self.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As his friend, I shouldn't reveal the truth about his identity. That would only make things worse for him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dragonspine has a frigid climate and is covered in snow all year round. Even so, it's home to various monsters and creatures that can withstand the cold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Deep within the mountain lies the remains of an even more mysterious creature — Durin. Although the dragon has been dead for a long time, he still possesses a peculiar life energy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, a lot of strange things have happened on Dragonspine...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I almost forgot! Paimon and I once encountered someone on Dragonspine who looked exactly like Albedo, and we weren't the only ones.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a second! Someone who looks exactly like him...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, that doesn't make sense...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hi. Anything the Knights can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I'm Swan. I mostly perform sentry duty.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I also provide any necessary assistance to our business visitors in accordance with the Knights of Favonius Handbook.

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: Yes. The Knights of Favonius Handbook is our instructional guide, and also the cornerstone of peace and prosperity in Mondstadt...

choices.text: Is there anywhere good to go in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: ...Sorry, I can't find anything at all about that in the Knights of Favonius Handbook...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Bye-bye!

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: May Barbatos and his gentle wind protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: If you discover anything of concern, you can always report it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything worth visiting in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: If it's your first time here, I recommend visiting the Mondstadt Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: If you're tired, go have some of Mondstadt's famous wine at a tavern called "Angel's Share."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: Goodbye, traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Knights of Favonius!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: This is the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: Here you can find the Grand Master's office, the Library, and all manner of other facilities.

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: As much as I would love to give you the grand tour, I'm afraid I have to stay at my post.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Athos
dialogues.text: I hope you find what you need here.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: ...Welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius Headquarters... You don't look like a troublemaker, so you can go in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Best wishes to you.
